title: auth and storage resources (Google sign-in, groups, triggers)
description:
Implement `design/storage.md` §1.1. **Don't deploy.** Reference: `/Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/amplify/auth/resource.ts` and `storage/resource.ts`.

## Files
- **`auth/resource.ts`:** email plus Google (`secret('GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID')`, `secret('GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET')`, scopes `email profile openid`). Callback and logout URLs come from `APRICITUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS`, defaulting to `http://localhost:5173/` and `http://127.0.0.1:5181/`. Groups `members`, `curators`, `admins`. `allow.resource(postConfirmation).to(['addUserToGroup'])`.
- **`auth/pre-sign-up/{resource.ts,handler.ts}`:** reject sign-ups whose email isn't in `ALLOWED_EMAILS` (`secret('ALLOWED_EMAILS')`, comma-separated, case-insensitive), including Google sign-ups (`PreSignUp_ExternalProvider`). Put the check in a pure function, `isAllowed(email, list)`, in `auth/allow-list.ts`.
- **`auth/post-confirmation/{resource.ts,handler.ts}`:** add the user to `members` with `AdminAddUserToGroupCommand` (`@aws-sdk/client-cognito-identity-provider`).
- **`storage/resource.ts`:** `defineStorage({ name: 'apricitusFiles', isDefault: true, access })`. `audio/*`, `analysis/*` and `documents/*` are readable by `members` and read/write/delete for `curators`; `uploads/{entity_id}/*` belongs to its owner.
- Wire the triggers in `backend.ts` if needed.

## Verify
```
cd web && npx tsc --noEmit -p amplify/tsconfig.json
node --test amplify/auth/allow-list.test.ts   # or via tsx: npx tsx --test amplify/auth/allow-list.test.ts
npx tsx scripts/print-sdl.ts > /dev/null
```
